name: paypal-desk
description: A resident desk for PayPal merchants: a background module watches invoices, disputes and payments through PayPal's MCP server, a live dashboard shows them, and the agent works each case with your confirmation.

description.en: Your PayPal account, watched in the background: sales, overdue invoices and open disputes as live figures, and an agent that works each case with your confirmation.
description.zh-CN: 后台持续关注你的 PayPal 账户：销售、逾期发票和未决争议实时呈现，每个待办由 agent 处理、由你确认。
